prompt:
Create ONE original Crusader Kings III doctrine UI icon, matching the native doctrine icons in the references.
Input roles: images 1–3 are actual vanilla doctrine texture masks (male-dominated, righteous, monotheism); image 4 is the real game UI screenshot showing their final subdued blue-grey appearance. The very bright gold/red circular icon in that screenshot is the REJECTED old design; do not imitate it. Do not edit or reproduce the screenshot.
Deliver ONLY the new isolated icon on a genuinely transparent square background.
Subject: a compact dynastic family-tree symbol: a stout rooted central trunk branching into three simple human head-and-shoulder silhouettes, all joined as one clean recognizable genealogy emblem. Keep a small number of broad shapes and generous open gaps. No circles or frames around the heads.
Native texture requirements: solid pure BLACK #000000 silhouette, opaque interior, transparent exterior, antialiased alpha only at the outer edges. This is an ALPHA MASK for the game's shader, not a precolored illustration. No grey-blue pigment baked into the pixels, no lighting, no texture, no gradients, no shadows, no highlights.
Match the references' centered occupancy and padding: subject roughly two-thirds of the square width and three-quarters of its height, with clear transparent margins. Use heavy readable silhouette forms that remain distinct when displayed at 24–32 pixels. Flat front view.
No gold, red, white, jewelry, filigree, circular medallion, shield, crown, border, ornamental leaves, tiny branches, text, letters, numbers, watermark or background. The final art should look like it belongs beside the very simple native doctrine silhouettes, with a distinctive genealogy subject.
